# Grahm Route & Offers: How to find him immediately (Supermutant dealer)

![Grahm Route & Offers: How to find him immediately (Supermutant dealer)](/uploads/46_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

[Update July 18, 2023] New plans

You all know Grahm, the friendly super mutant with his moo-cow Chally. Many here in the Nuka Knights community also know what he has to offer. But most people don't know that you can find it specifically.

## HOW DOES GRAHMS ROUTE “WORK”?

Grahm starts his route on a new server at the Monongah Power Plant and from there runs either up the mountain or down the road. This means you need a “new” server on which you can visit it. A new server always starts at 11:00 a.m. (See PipBoy).

## FIND GRAHM IMMEDIATELY

To do this, you need yourself or a team member who has Fallout 1st, as this is the only place where a private server is included.

Now you need a “new” server. You will receive this if you have not been on your private server that day anyway, or if you go to a public server for about 10 minutes and then to a private server.

The best option is:

- Join public server & stay there for about 10 minutes
- travel to the Monongah Power Plant
- Go to the main menu and enter the private world
- Now you spawn on the private world directly at the Mononah power plant
- If Grahm isn't directly there, check your PipBoy under the "Data" tab; the date is there at the bottom left.
- The server was spawned at 11 a.m., i.e. the longer it is after 11 in your area, the further Grahm ran from the spawn point.
- Now you either walk up the mountain along the road or down the mountain and meet Grahm.
